description.value: Brown Bridge Pub is a neighbourhood pub established in 2008 on Vermilion Avenue in Princeton, BC, in the Okanagan-Similkameen region. It serves a wide scratch-kitchen menu spanning wings, tacos, burgers, poutine, and ramen bowls alongside weekly specials. Princeton sits at a key crossroads for cyclists riding the Crowsnest Highway or exploring the Similkameen Valley, making this a natural mid-route meal stop.
